principle: QoL is first-class parity, not optional polish. Visible-but-inert affordances are FAIL.

qol.qol_detail: model/CLIP/VAE controls autofill from captured workflow bindings and populate valid choices via model picker (not plain text)
controls use correct control types (multiline/integer/float/select/model-picker/image), numeric bounds enforced
low-frequency controls live under Advanced; Advanced is a collapsible disclosure whose state persists
controls can be reordered; order/rows/Advanced placement persist (shelf.layout.v1) and values persist per workflow/version (shelf.values.v1)
seed has compact randomize action; -1 means random
dropdown (sampler/scheduler/model) choices populate from graph + backend inventory, not empty statics
stale upload cannot overwrite current image (upload race guard)
wizard suggestion is automatic graph-order candidate discovery with exact-target confirm; explicit Suggest affordance must not silently replace autofill semantics
wizard View centers graph on node with offset fallback + 3s magenta highlight; highlights cleared on re-render/close
per-selection control drafts restore; explicit user overrides only are submitted
recommended Steps offered only when a valid workflow-derived recommendation exists
image control offers Clear when populated; history browse; canvas link/use
detail overlay: focus captured, initial control focused, focus restored on close; Escape/backdrop close; menus close on Escape/outside-click
compare: full-resolution assets prefer Original; divider draggable, arrow-key control, focus-safe updates
history picker filters retained in-memory (explicitly not persisted); density persisted
experiment cells keep stable order across polls; omitted/new cells never reorder prior cells
tooltips/labels/states on generate bar, queue positions, cell axis labels preserved
source/reference ownership correct: reserved I2I socket, VAE/consumer boundary, confirmation/order/capacity in mapping
placeholder tools visibly gated with reasons and execution-disabled (never silently submittable)
hash routing fail-soft: unrelated/malformed hashes never throw, never fabricate a route
